mapper.select: SELECT id, consignee, phone, province, city, district, detail, is_default FROM t_address WHERE user_id =#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_address ( user_id,consignee, phone, province, city, district, detail,is_default,update_time,create_time) VALUES (#{userId},#{consignee},#{phone},#{province},#{city},#{district},#{detail},#{isDefault},NOW(),NOW())
